card.name: The word on before a posting date
card.fires_on: The word "on" (or "On") right after a byline such as "Submitted by brad" or "Posted By", just before a date. Also fires on "last on" or "last modified" before a date, and on digits inside ISSN or DOI numbers.

modes.label: Byline then date
modes.description: "on" after a poster's name, just before a date or weekday.

modes.label: Last reviewed or modified
modes.description: "on" or "modified" after "last", just before a date.

modes.label: Digits in reference codes
modes.description: A single digit inside an ISSN or DOI number.

card.plain: It marks the little word "on" that comes before a date in web post bylines and update notes.
